verses.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਰਸ ਸਮ ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਧਾਰਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhirasaT dharas sam dharas dhiaan dhaar dhubidhaa nivaar ek Tek geh leejeeaai ||

en.bdb: With harbouring the thought of seeing all alike and beholding the Lord and discarding feelings of I, my or me from the mind, 'acquire the support of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੌਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਜੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv asatut ni(n)dhaa chhaadd akath kathaa beechaar mauan brat keejeeaai ||

en.bdb: Leaving praise and slander of others, one should Endeavour, to unite the divine words of the Guru in the mind, feel engrossed in it. Its contemplation is beyond description. So it is best to remain quiet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਜਗੁ ਜਗ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੂਲ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੀਜੀਐ॥
verses.translit_en: jag jeevan mai jag jag jagajeevan kai jaaneeaai jeevan mool jug jug jeejeeaai||

en.bdb: Consider God, the Creator and the Universe-His creation is as one. And once God is known thus, then one lives for many eons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਉ ਅਨੇਕ ਏਕ ਸਰਬ ਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੀਐ ॥੨੫੨॥
verses.translit_en: ek hee anek aau anek ek sarab mai braham bibek Tek prem ras peejeeaai ||252||

en.bdb: If one understands that His light pervades in all the Living beings and light of all living beings pervades in Him. Then this knowledge of the Lord dispenses loving elixir to seeker. (252)
